description: A mark's default position is read from the **whole** chain. `pointPositionDefaultRef` asks `getMarkPropOrConfig(channel, markDef, config, {vgChannel})`, which walks the definition under Vega's name for the channel and then Vega-Lite's, and then the configuration the same way — the style blocks, `config[marktype]` under each name, `config.mark`. Read as the definition alone, a theme that places every arc at a radius or every label at an angle placed nothing at all: the mark fell through to the default it would have taken untouched, an arc to `min(width,height)/2` and a text to no angle. The first row is an arc whose radius a theme sets; the second is a text whose angle and radius a theme sets, so the labels stand off the centre at a fixed turn rather than following their slices. A theme's value is still outranked by the mark's own, which the third row states to keep that order drawn rather than assumed.
